2.1.4.en: Added: Dates will also be converted from string if it matches the Homey Localization (for now that means GB), f.i.: 11/15/2022, 6:00:00 PM.

2.1.5.en: Added: Method d() within BLL coding or expressions: converts a string into a date.

2.1.6.en: Removed: Method d() within BLL coding or expressions: No need yet: EN by default.

2.1.7.en: Change: The new Expressioncards will use default text-arguments instead of code-arguments, to support default flows.

2.1.8.en: Change: The new Expressioncards will use default text-arguments instead of code-arguments, to support default flows.

2.1.9.en: Added: String posibility within date-formats by using double-quotes "text".

2.1.10.en: Improved: Functions editing view in App Settings is more advanced.

2.1.12.en: Bugfixed: dev.getData error solved in newly created slider.

2.3.0.en: Added: Custom datetime formats can now be added in the Settings --> Formats. And some Settings UI improvements.

2.3.3.en: Improved: Bufixes and improved Error handling in flowcards.

2.3.4.en: Improved: BLL datetime object improvements for Simple Log.

2.3.5.en: Improved: Many coding improvements and BLL improvements for Simple Log.

2.3.6.en: Improved: More BLL improvements (for Simple Log).

2.3.8.en: New: File Server for retrieving files securely through the Homey App (App Settings).
